title: Omarchy Ham Station Profile
description: The shared station wiring and operator identity for Omarchy ham radio apps.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for editors. Consumers ignore it.

version.description: Profile format version. Version 1 is frozen; changes require a new version.

operator.description: Operator identity. Apps may write these fields on explicit user action.

callsign.description: Amateur callsign, normalised to uppercase with any portable suffix retained.

grid.description: Maidenhead grid locator: 4, 6 or 8 characters. Canonical display is 6 characters.

gridSource.description: Whether the grid is hand-entered or may be updated from a GPS fix.

station.description: The station paths the operator declares. A declaration, never an inference.

paths.description: Every path this station expects. Both values mean both paths, not a third kind.

audio.description: Radio audio roles. Each role is independent; an absent role is unassigned.

node.description: PipeWire node.name of a non-stream source (rx) or sink (tx).

tnc.description: The modem transport for a TNC station path.

baud.description: Serial baud rate. Meaningful only for a serial transport.

path.description: A stable device path, preferably /dev/serial/by-id/... rather than /dev/ttyACM0.

cat.description: The CAT endpoint. The rigctld process owns the rig model, serial speed and PTT wiring.

kind.description: The only CAT endpoint kind in version 1.

host.description: Host where rigctld listens. Consumers apply this default when the field is absent.

port.description: TCP port where rigctld listens. Consumers apply this default when the field is absent.
